description: List folders, optionally filtered by parent_id (e.g. to list children of fd_root). Sorted by name.

parent_id.description: Optional parent folder id to filter by (empty string means top-level).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of {fdid, name, parent_id, path, created_at}.

description: Retrieve a folder record by fdid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full folder record.

description: Create a new folder under the given parent. Path is derived from the parent's path + name.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new folder record.

description: Delete a folder. Fails if the folder has sub-folders. Files directly inside are removed (along with their versions).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {fdid, removed_files}.

description: List files, optionally filtered by folder_id, is_trashed, and/or is_starred. Sorted by name.

folder_id.description: Optional folder id to filter by.

is_trashed.description: Optional filter: only trashed (true) or only untrashed (false).

is_starred.description: Optional filter: only starred (true) or only unstarred (false).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of file summaries.

description: Retrieve the full file record by fid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full file record including current_version_id.

description: Upload (create) a new file inside a folder. Automatically creates version 1 pointing to the initial upload.

size_bytes.description: Size of the uploaded blob in bytes.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new file summary.

description: Permanently delete a file, including all its versions and any share links pointing at it.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {fid, deleted: true, removed_versions}.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated file summary.

description: Remove the starred flag from a file.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated file summary.

description: Move a file to trash (soft-delete). It remains listable via is_trashed=true.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated file summary.

description: Restore a trashed file (clear the is_trashed flag).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated file summary.

description: List all versions for a given file, sorted by version_number ascending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of version records.

description: Create a new version of a file (auto-incremented version_number) and set it as current.

size_bytes.description: Size of the new version blob.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new version record.

description: Set an existing version as the current version of the file.

version_id.description: Version identifier that must belong to file_id.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {fid, current_version_id, version_number}.

description: List share links, optionally filtered by target_kind (file|folder) and/or target_id.

target_id.description: Optional target identifier to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of share link records.

description: Create a new share link for a file or folder.

target_id.description: Identifier of the file or folder to share.

can_edit.description: Whether the link grants edit permission.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO datetime after which the link expires.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new share link record.

description: Search files and folders by keyword across names, paths, and (for files) mime types.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {files: [...], folders: [...]}.

description: Return drive-wide statistics: totals for folders, files, versions, share links, active size, trashed size, starred count, and counts by folder.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a stats dictionary.
